newsitem.title: USA: Streicher restates Q3, nine-month EPS down.
newsitem.headline: Streicher restates Q3, nine-month EPS down.

text.p: Streicher Mobile Fueling Inc said Monday that it has restated its earnings for the three months and nine months, ended October 31, 1996, as a result of certain errors identified during its year-end audit.
The company said that third quarter earnings have been revised downward to a loss of $0.04 a share, instead of a profit of $0.11 a share.
For the nine-month period earnings have be revised downward to a net loss of $0.20 a share, instead of a loss of $0.05 per share.
The company said the errors were primarily related to accounts payable.
